credits_cram.why: "CRAM is the method of Hoover et al.; we rebuild it independently from the paper description" and "This paper is a small replication-and-comparison study, not a new method."

cites_hoover.why: Hoover et al. are named with an arXiv number in the text, but the only \citep in that sentence is hopfield1985tsp. No \cite points to the CRAM paper.

small_n.why: "the direct-LLM condition uses only 5--10 puzzles per model because of cost, so its accuracy estimates carry wide uncertainty."

handset_caveat.why: "a hand-set energy with one weight value and no training solves 497/500... matching the learned energies (496--497)"

their_numbers.why: "The original paper reports 42 ms on an H200 GPU; that figure is theirs and was not measured by us"; the 99.996% figure is also marked as not verified here.

no_new_claims.why: All results match the log. The Wilson intervals and the 99.2% lower bound are derived from logged counts, not new experiments. No extra baselines or runs are introduced.
